title: Evidence
description: One observed fact emitted by a signal. Signals emit evidence, never verdicts. The arbiter turns evidence into a score.

id.description: Stable within one verdict; reasons cite these ids.

signal.description: Registered signal name, e.g. url.homograph, page.cred_form, rep.openphish.

observed.description: Machine-readable observed value (bool, number, string or small object). Never raw page HTML; strings max 512 chars, defanged if they are URLs.

display.description: Short human text for the UI, already output-encoded by the renderer, never HTML.

weight.description: Contribution the arbiter assigned (log-odds points). Filled by the arbiter, 0 if the signal is informational.

hard_rule.description: Id of the hard rule this evidence triggered, if any (docs/SCORING.md).

source.description: Where it came from: computed | rdap | crt | openphish | gsb | urlhaus | sandbox | registry | llm:<role> | user.

error.description: Set when the signal failed or timed out; the verdict is then degraded.
